name: Gym Spatial
summary:
Transform your workout routine by stepping into fully immersive 3D environments, where you can run, ride or row, while being in different and fun worlds, from a space station to a pirate's bay, Paris or a futuristic city... When using a treadmill,  stationary bike, or a rowing machine, sync your speed with our immersive tracks on the control window, making cardio more engaging and fun than ever.
